item.title: Trump lands in China for historic meeting with Xi, Putin
item.description: President Donald Trump has landed in Shenzhen for historic trilateral talks with Chinese leader Xi Jinping and Russia's Vladimir Putin.

item.title: Nvidia stock up 3% as earnings beat expectations. Neoclouds surge
item.description: The chip giant's earnings come at a tumultuous time for the company.

item.title: Nvidia’s Kress tells CNBC's Jim Cramer that 'customers continue to be with us’
item.description: Nvidia released fiscal third-quarter 2027 results on Tuesday, followed by its first earnings call since Huang's departure.

item.description: Nvidia shares rose in extended trading after the company’s first earnings report since co-founder Jensen Huang resigned last week.

item.title: Iran says army targets U.S. drone and missile sites in Kuwait as Gulf attacks mount
item.description: Iran said its army targeted U.S. drone and missile installations at Kuwait's Ali Al Salem air base, extending a run of attacks on Gulf states.

item.title: Putin says EU is losing industry, falling behind competition, ahead of meeting with Trump and Xi
item.description: Putin used the speech to emphasize Russia's economic resilience despite U.S. sanctions, and played up opportunities for APEC members in the country.

item.title: Democrat Mary Peltola wins Alaska Senate election
item.description: Peltola's defeat of incumbent Republican Dan Sullivan gives Democrats a solid majority of 56 seats in the Senate as of January.

item.title: Treasury yields hold steady as investors look ahead to Fed minutes
item.description: U.S. Treasury yields were broadly flat on Wednesday, as Wall Street awaits the release of the latest FOMC minutes.

item.title: Senators press acting U.S. Navy Secretary on Iran war costs, sailor health in confirmation hearing
item.description: Acting Navy Secretary Hung Cao told senators the Navy recoded and used munitions he called expired as the Iran war strains weapons stocks and naval deployments.

item.title: Emergency alerts and $75,000 rewards: South Korea fights high-tech exam cheating
item.description: South Korea moves to crack down on exam cheating with emergency alerts and $75,000 rewards.

item.description: Ukraine's charge d'affaires to the U.S., Denys Sienik, said that Starshield had been speed-limited for seven days already in Ukraine.

item.title: Aschenbrenner’s Situational Awareness made AI bets again before October rout
item.description: Leopold Aschenbrenner's hedge fund, which almost collapsed over the summer, bought AI stocks before shares began tumbling.

item.title: Trump’s accounts traded up to $97.5 million in Nvidia as Huang gained White House access
item.description: Trump’s accounts sold up to $1 million in Nvidia stock five days after he was briefed on Jensen Huang’s relationship with a suspected Chinese spy.

item.title: Trump withdraws Heidi Overton as nominee to lead Food and Drug Administration, sources say
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump has withdrawn the nomination of Heidi Overton to lead the Food and Drug Administration due to insufficient support in Congress.

item.description: JPMorgan and Hyundai Card are looking to expand the use of AI agents in financial transactions.

item.description: LeBron James sued an AI-powered sports betting startup over alleged unauthorized use of his likeness.

item.title: OpenAI bugging case defendant Alfozan set for trial in January
item.description: Abdulrahman Alfozan has been held without bail since his arrest in October, after prosecutors said he planted a listening device in an OpenAI conference room.

item.description: Chief U.S. equity strategist Ben Snider expects the bull market to continue, even if the advance isn't as explosive as it has been.

Homebuilder sentiment plunges to 14-year low, leading more builders to drop prices
